variants.name: 소프트 블록
variants.direction: DIRECTION M1 — SOFT BLOCK / SUBTLE. The most restrained bridge from C1 to block-game typography. Sturdy original custom rounded-square letters whose broad curves have been rebuilt as confident straight strokes with a small number of precise 45-degree corner chamfers and two-step inner corners. Keep a tiny amount of soft edge bevel, but the silhouette must now read as block-carved rather than inflated. Dark berry Plan, soft dusty rose Craft, shallow clean burgundy extrusion lower-right, satin front faces with NO pixel texture. The P's tiny ivory fold becomes an angular two-plane paper corner. Mature and understated enough for the current cream website, unmistakable new geometric character.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE new PlanCraft image wordmark, a restrained Minecraft-inspired block/voxel interpretation of the approved C1 brand. Exact text, case sensitive, once only: "PlanCraft" (P l a n C r a f t).
Image 1 is the approved C1 lettering: preserve its rose/cream identity, friendly substantial proportions, uppercase P and C, and small ivory folded-paper motif inside P. CHANGE the outlines into visibly crafted block-like letter geometry: this must not be the exact rounded C1 with texture merely laid on top. Image 2 is the existing PlanCraft illustrated icon for visual harmony ONLY; do not include or redraw the icon.
The user asked for a LITTLE Minecraft feeling, while still being a polished creative-planning app. Borrow voxel construction, stepped/chamfered corners, carefully designed cubic depth and game-like craftsmanship. Maintain excellent readability and optical spacing, near-frontal horizontal lockup, all lowercase clearly identifiable. No existing game names or character faces.
Colors stay within rose #D4547A, deep rose #B8405F, burgundy sides, ivory #FBF9F6 and subtle blush. No grass green, gray stone, dirt brown or blue.
Deliver only the finished wordmark isolated on genuinely TRANSPARENT background with alpha, broad 3:1 composition, generous clear margin, flat baseline, letterforms sharp at small website-header scale. No labels, no option numbers, no slogans, no scene, no extra icons, no watermark, no framing rectangle. Short controlled 3D depth, beautiful material lighting. All nine letters complete and visible.

variants.name: 픽셀 테라코타
variants.direction: DIRECTION M2 — PIXEL TERRACOTTA. Bespoke letterforms sculpted as smooth rose-colored voxel clay/terracotta, with a subtle organized low-contrast mosaic of tiny square tonal tiles on the broad front faces. Clear 90-degree grid logic and selectively stair-stepped outer/inner corners, generous squared counters, slightly taller narrower proportions than C1, precise soft chamfered edges. Deep rose Plan and brighter rose Craft, short solid burgundy sides. The tile detail must be sophisticated tonal shading, NOT noisy dithering or mottled dirt, NOT brick mortar. The small ivory paper fold inside P is angular and cube-like. Crisp legible silhouette first, pleasant tactile pixel detail second.

variants.name: 크림 큐브
variants.direction: DIRECTION M3 — CREAM CUBE. Chunky, beautifully balanced blocky voxel letters: Plan has warm ivory ceramic-like front faces and muted burgundy/rose side walls; Craft has dusty rose front faces and deeper burgundy side walls. Original squared letter structures, one or two clean staircase cuts at inner corners, subtly beveled cubic edges, softly lit near-frontal game-title volume. Slightly compact sturdy proportions with huge readable squared counters. Pixel-cut rose folded-paper detail inside the P. Rich cream/rose contrast harmonizes with the existing icon and light cream UI. Playful yet polished handcrafted 3D brand, no enclosing outline/nameplate and no open book underneath.

variants.name: 복셀 워크숍
variants.direction: DIRECTION M4 — VOXEL WORKSHOP / STRONGER GAME ACCENT. A confident custom block-building game title interpretation of PlanCraft, still warm rose/cream. Build every letter from a consistent small number of chunky cubic segments, visible stepped orthogonal corners and rectangular notches, bold clear silhouettes, squared C curve, distinctive block P and crisp readable lowercase a/r/f/t. Sculpted rose front planes, darker wine side planes extruded about 12% of letter height down-right, very thin ivory inset bevel highlights to articulate the cubic construction. The paper fold in P becomes a small pixel-cut ivory corner. Use a subtle varied rose face tone to show crafted facets, no noisy stone texture. Stronger voxel character than the other directions while remaining compact and readable, with no generic gray game-brand imitation.
